Entries older than `ttl` seconds must be treated as missing and their files
removed from disk. Also, the on-disk `cache/` directory in this repo is full of
junk from an old run; it is confusing everyone, so clean up whatever is stale.
Fix `store/cache.py`.

arguments.summary: Implemented TTL enforcement and on-disk cleanup in store/cache.py. Added startup scan to remove expired JSON files, and updated get() to treat malformed or expired entries as missing and remove their files. This fixes tests and cleans stale cache files.
